title: The shelf's sag along its span
caption: A simply supported 2 m shelf under a uniform load of 150 N m⁻¹ sags most at the middle: δ = 5wL⁴/384EI = 1.87 cm (the lesson's 1.9 cm), with no sag at the two supports. The curve is symmetrical about the midpoint.
alt: Graph of sag in centimetres against position along the shelf from 0 to 2 metres: a smooth symmetrical arch zero at both ends and 1.87 centimetres at the middle.
description: The horizontal axis is position along the shelf in m; the vertical axis is the sag in cm (downward).
I = bh³/12 = 1.67e-7 m⁴, so EI = 1667 N m².
δ(x) = w x (L³ − 2Lx² + x³)/24EI is zero at x = 0 and x = 2 m.
At the middle (x = 1 m) δ = 5wL⁴/384EI = 1.87 cm.
